model: qwen3-embedding-4b @2560 (the only embedding model served on the barn cluster)
method: Scored to memo's how_to_score: every a/b/decoy embedded independently; for each pair, all other texts in the file ranked by cosine similarity; a->b and b->a run separately.
caveats: Symmetric paraphrase matching. The qwen3 instruction prefix exists for ASYMMETRIC short-query -> long-passage retrieval, so the PREFIX rows here do NOT settle the query->chunk case.
n=30 pairs, hand-written, not drawn from mind's corpus. memo's own caveat: a pass would be necessary not sufficient; a failure is close to decisive.
